name.description: Image identifier, e.g. compute9.6-5.14.0-570.58.1.1.dug.el9. Used as the Nexus artifact prefix.

kernel_version.description: Kernel version baked into this image, informational + used in artifact naming.

repo.description: owner/repo of the Ansible playbook repository, e.g. dugeo/ansible.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out. Pin to a commit SHA for reproducible builds.

playbook.description: Path within the ansible repo to the playbook to run, e.g. playbooks/rocky-image-build/compute9.6-5.14.0-570.58.1.1.dug.el9.yml.

host.description: Host the playbook builds the image on (matches the playbook's own 'hosts:' entry, e.g. ppxe0001). Informational today; the playbook's inventory controls actual connection.

remote_user.description: Remote user for ansible-playbook --user. Defaults to the ansible.cfg remote_user if omitted.

publish.description: Optional archival copy. Not needed while a single host (e.g. ppxe0001) both builds and serves the image -- the playbook already deposits artifacts where it serves from. Fill this in when a separate serving target (e.g. an in-cluster PXE deployment) needs a durable, versioned copy instead of host-local files.

nexus_repository.description: Nexus raw hosted repository name that stores build archives, e.g. netboot-images.
